title: Hierarchical Familiarity Graph
objective: Define reusable, visibility-safe parent/child/adjacent familiarity graph relationships over stable KFR-01 subject and canonical owner references without replacing owner taxonomies, forcing one universal tree, or implying familiarity, competence, transfer, permission or canonical mutation.

resolved_contract.node_basis: Stable KFR-01 familiarity subject references plus canonical owner references and owner versions.
resolved_contract.graph_shape: Domain-specific directed graph shapes are allowed. The KFR graph is not a replacement taxonomy and need not form one universal rigid tree.
resolved_contract.cycle_rule: Deterministic projection must terminate safely even when source relationships contain cycles; cycles are represented as topology, not traversed as authority or competence inheritance.
resolved_contract.unknown_rule: Explicit unknown remains unknown. Graph presence, adjacency or ancestry cannot invent familiarity.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Unauthorized nodes and incident edges are filtered before projection, counts, search, explanation, deterministic receipts or AI context; hidden cardinality is never leaked.
resolved_contract.transfer_boundary: No transfer percentages, confidence degradation, incompatibility weighting, inheritance of competence or automatic qualification. Those remain KFR-04/KFR-05 scope.
resolved_contract.owner_boundary: Canonical owner taxonomies and entity state remain authoritative; KFR-02 stores references only and performs no owner mutation.
resolved_contract.persistence_decision: No durable KFR-02 persistence. The graph is a deterministic code/governance projection over stable canonical references; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
resolved_contract.accessibility: Graph topology, node labels, edge kinds, unknown state and authority explanations require accessible nonvisual equivalents; visual layout is not semantic truth.
resolved_contract.validation: Exactly one current KFR-02 Validation Core profile, zero historical predecessor fanout, genuine RED before production, self-hosted Linux/Windows plus deterministic comparator on one exact final head.

preserved_boundaries: KFR-01 remains completed_verified with implementation authority retired.
Character, Progression/Skill, Profession/DPL, Research, Vehicle/platform/facility, Asset/Equipment, Organization/relationship, World/WCI and Permission/visibility owners remain canonical.
KFR-02 defines graph topology only; no Character familiarity records, transfer/confidence rules, operator qualification, mentorship/learning integration or KFR-03+ behavior is authorized.
No durable KFR-02 persistence and no migration 0022 reservation.
ODL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.

KFR-01 contract confirms stable visibility-filtered subject/owner references and no persistence requirement for a deterministic graph-definition tranche.
